# Porta site

> Source code of the marketing and waitlist landing page for Porta ("AirDrop with links"), an iPhone app that turns your phone into a temporary personal sharing node: pick a file, get a live link, approve the receiver's request, and the file streams directly from the phone to any browser with no cloud upload and no account for the receiver.

- What it is: a single-page React marketing site with a waitlist form (stored in localStorage until a backend exists)
- Stack: React 18, TypeScript, Vite 6, hand-written CSS, SVG "liquid glass" filters (feDisplacementMap + feSpecularLighting)
- Live site: https://porta-site-alpha.vercel.app, hosted on Vercel
- License: MIT
